# Contribution policy

SPV Property Calculator is publicly viewable proprietary software. It is not an
open-source project and is not accepting unsolicited code contributions.

Do not submit a pull request, patch, translation, design, image, documentation,
or other contribution unless Keyur Gohil has expressly requested it or agreed
to it in writing before submission. Opening an issue or discussion does not
constitute that agreement.

Any approved contribution must be covered by written terms confirming that the
contributor has the right to provide it and granting the project owner the
rights needed to use, modify, relicense, distribute, and commercialise it.
Contributions may be declined for any reason.

The repository's [proprietary notice](../LICENSE) applies to all project material
unless a file is clearly identified as third-party material under separate
terms.

Security vulnerabilities must not be reported through a public issue. Follow
the private reporting instructions in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
